Searching photos by day and date no longer working In my Google Photos library, I used to be able to search for all photos posted on a particular date, across all years. For example, I could search for "3 November", and it would show all photos taken on 3 November, for every year in my library. Starting a couple of days ago, this no longer works. Searching for any day and date within speech marks returns a No Results window. I've checked manually, and the photos are there in the library - nothing has been removed or changed. I have tried various searches using a combination of terms, with and without speech marks, but the results vary wildly. Just 3 November gives me some, but not all, photos with "3" and "November" (presumably in the filenames). November 3 is more accurate, as it seems to capture all of the 3 November photos, as well as every other file with November and 3 in it. Adding a suffix (3rd, or 1st, or 4th) seems to give random results. Putting things in speech marks returns No Results. It seems like Google has changed something in the last few days, and broken this search functionality. Is there any other way of bringing up photos for a particular day and date in my library?
